result.instructions: Tools for Zigaflow, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which quotations are still open, and what is each worth?"; "List the jobs updated this week and their status."; "How much free stock do we have of product code POLO-150?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Zigaflow data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run zigaflow_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run zigaflow_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run zigaflow_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. zigaflow_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.
